mapper.sql: id, order_no, item_id, item_title, cover_image, buyer_id, seller_id, final_price, address_id, status, pay_time, deliver_time, receive_time, logistics_company, tracking_number, create_time, refund_reason, refund_audit_time, refund_audit_result
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_info (order_no, item_id, item_title, cover_image, buyer_id, seller_id, final_price, address_id, status) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{itemId}, #{itemTitle}, #{coverImage}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{finalPrice}, #{addressId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE order_info SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE order_info SET status = 2, logistics_company = #{logisticsCompany}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, deliver_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE order_info SET status = 3, receive_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE order_info SET status = 6 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE order_info SET status = 5, refund_audit_time = NOW(), refund_audit_result = #{auditResult} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4
UPDATE order_info SET status = 1, refund_audit_time = NOW(), refund_audit_result = #{auditResult} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4
mapper.select:

create_time DESC refund_audit_time DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
